text: "Carpentry is the skilled trade of constructing or repairing structures such as buildings, cabinets, and furniture using wood and other materials. A key part of the process involves sawing, where a sharp blade is used to cut wood into precise pieces. Sawing is often the first step in the construction process, providing the necessary measurements and shapes to create the desired structure. As the project progresses, the wood is carefully sanded to smooth out any rough edges, ensuring the final product is both functional and aesthetically pleasing. Sanding also helps to remove any imperfections in the wood, creating a more refined and durable finish. Through the combination of sawing and sanding, carpenters can bring their designs to life, crafting beautiful and reliable structures that serve a variety of purposes."
